Before we go any further, I have one question that matters more to me than price. How long have you been doing this? I ask because we have been in Brazil for eighteen months, and honestly it feels like five years. Our last provider had only been running for two years when we signed with them, and they could not handle our volume. Every month there was a problem with payroll. So what I want to know is simple: how long has your firm been in the market, and has anyone independent ever audited your processes? Get those two right and we can talk about everything else.

Thank you. Let me give you the short version of who we are. We were established in 2003 and we are headquartered in Lisbon. We have been serving international companies for over twenty years, and our headcount has doubled since 2019, from forty people to eighty. We work with a hundred and forty clients, and most of them have been with us for more than five years. Every process we run has been audited every year since 2015. And before we talk about pricing at all, I would rather send you two client references, so you can hear it from them instead of from me.
